# Native layer-color references

These synthetic fixtures were captured from CLIP STUDIO PAINT EX 5.0.4 in October 2026.
The reference PNGs are the native `CanvasPreview.ImageData` of saved CLIP documents,
not images generated by Paperback. They are 256 × 128, the original canvas size.

`manifest.json` contains only the synthetic layer hierarchy, decoded source/mask
dimensions and offsets, blend/visibility attributes, and whitelisted native fields:
`LayerType`, `DrawColorEnable`, `DrawColorMain/Sub{Red,Green,Blue}`,
`LayerEffectAttached`, and the base64 `LayerEffectInfo` block (`edge`).
UUIDs, document history and machine paths are excluded. Source and mask pixels are
deduplicated, gzip-compressed RGBA bytes. Tests decode native effect fields and run
the application renderer against the native PNGs, allowing one level per channel
on white. Separate tests check alpha preservation and opaque native color ramps.

## Synthetic input

The chart has gray, red, green and blue ramps at y=0–15, 16–31, 32–47 and 48–63.
The ramp value is x. Below y=64, RGB is `(x, (y−64)*4, (x*37+y*19)%256)`.
Alpha is 255 until y=95, then 0, 64, 128 and 192 in successive eight-row strips.

The folder fixture imports the chart through a layered PSD into a normal folder:

- `chart` has a mask of 0 for x<64, 128 for x<128, otherwise 255.
- `overlay` is a 96 × 64 solid `(50,220,100)` at (80,16), above the chart, Multiply.
- The folder mask has values 255, 128, 64 and 0 in successive 32-row strips.

Each change below was made and saved in CSP. Saving with the color effect enabled
leaves the source raster unchanged; the reference preview contains the effect.
The chart imported through PSD has separate source bytes because of image round trips.

| Fixture | Native setting |
|---|---|
| 01-off | Original chart, layer color off |
| 02-default | Main `(62,140,236)`, sub white |
| 03-main | Main `(200,32,64)`, sub white |
| 04-sub | Main `(200,32,64)`, sub `(32,220,160)` |
| 05-off-again | Color disabled, saved color values retained |
| 06-color-edge | Both custom colors, white border of radius 3 |
| 07-folder-off | Folder/child masks enabled, colors off |
| 08-folder-color | Default color on folder, both masks enabled |
| 09-folder-mask-disabled | Same color, folder mask disabled |
| 10-nested-color | Default colors on folder and chart, both masks enabled |
| 11-nested-color-edge | Nested colors/masks plus white chart border of radius 3 |

The border effect uses CSP's image-source setting. Other border-source modes and
special effects are not covered by these references. These data can be shared
under the repository's license; they contain no production artwork.
